import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert date and time to datetime
df['datetime'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'] + ' ' + df['time'])
df['hour'] = df['datetime'].dt.hour
df['day_of_week'] = df['datetime'].dt.day_name()

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(18, 12))
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Define grid for subplots
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Revenue by product (top left)
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
product_revenue = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
bars1 = ax1.bar(product_revenue.index, product_revenue.values, color=sns.color_palette('husl', len(product_revenue)))
ax1.set_title('Total Revenue by Product', fontweight='bold', pad=12)
ax1.set_xlabel('Product')
ax1.set_ylabel('Total Revenue ($)')
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax1.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)
for bar in bars1:
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax1.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + max(product_revenue.values)*0.01,
             f'${height:,.0f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=8)

# 2. Sales quantity by size (top middle)
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
size_counts = df['size'].value_counts()
colors2 = plt.cm.Set3(np.linspace(0, 1, len(size_counts)))
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax2.pie(size_counts.values, labels=size_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%',
                                   colors=colors2, startangle=90, textprops={'fontsize': 9})
ax2.set_title('Sales Distribution by Size', fontweight='bold', pad=12)
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('black')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')

# 3. Hourly sales pattern (top right)
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
hourly_sales = df.groupby('hour')['total'].sum()
ax3.plot(hourly_sales.index, hourly_sales.values, marker='o', linewidth=2, markersize=6, color='darkorange')
ax3.fill_between(hourly_sales.index, hourly_sales.values, alpha=0.3, color='orange')
ax3.set_title('Hourly Sales Revenue Pattern', fontweight='bold', pad=12)
ax3.set_xlabel('Hour of Day')
ax3.set_ylabel('Total Revenue ($)')
ax3.set_xticks(range(0, 24, 3))
ax3.grid(alpha=0.3)
ax3.set_xlim(-0.5, 23.5)

# 4. Revenue by age group (middle left)
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
age_order = ['18-24', '25-34', '35-44', '45-54', '55+']
age_revenue = df.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum().reindex(age_order)
bars4 = ax4.bar(age_revenue.index, age_revenue.values, color=sns.color_palette('Blues', len(age_revenue)))
ax4.set_title('Revenue by Customer Age Group', fontweight='bold', pad=12)
ax4.set_xlabel('Age Group')
ax4.set_ylabel('Total Revenue ($)')
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)
for bar in bars4:
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax4.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + max(age_revenue.values)*0.01,
             f'${height:,.0f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=8)

# 5. Takeaway vs Dine-in (middle)
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
takeaway_counts = df['is_takeaway'].value_counts()
takeaway_labels = ['Dine-in', 'Takeaway']
colors5 = ['lightblue', 'lightcoral']
wedges5, texts5, autotexts5 = ax5.pie(takeaway_counts.values, labels=takeaway_labels, autopct='%1.1f%%',
                                      colors=colors5, startangle=90, textprops={'fontsize': 10})
ax5.set_title('Takeaway vs Dine-in Distribution', fontweight='bold', pad=12)
for autotext in autotexts5:
    autotext.set_color('black')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')

# 6. Payment method distribution (middle right)
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
payment_counts = df['payment_method'].value_counts()
bars6 = ax6.bar(payment_counts.index, payment_counts.values, color=sns.color_palette('Greens', len(payment_counts)))
ax6.set_title('Payment Method Distribution', fontweight='bold', pad=12)
ax6.set_xlabel('Payment Method')
ax6.set_ylabel('Number of Transactions')
ax6.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax6.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)
for bar in bars6:
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax6.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + max(payment_counts.values)*0.01,
             f'{int(height)}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=8)

# 7. Average transaction value by product and size (bottom row - spans all columns)
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, :])
pivot_data = df.pivot_table(values='total', index='product', columns='size', aggfunc='mean')
sns.heatmap(pivot_data, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='YlOrRd', cbar_kws={'label': 'Average Transaction Value ($)'}, ax=ax7)
ax7.set_title('Average Transaction Value by Product and Size', fontweight='bold', pad=12)
ax7.set_xlabel('Size')
ax7.set_ylabel('Product')

# Adjust layout and save
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
